description: Use when a domain has vanished from DNS and the person asks whether it expired or is on hold. Returns the registry's RDAP statuses and what each means for resolution, the dates and its nameservers; no contacts.

domain.description: The registered domain or a hostname under it, e.g. example.com. Also accepted as "name"; a URL is reduced to its host.
